run_filter_lexicon: run the script to filter a lexicon file using a fairseq unit dictionary via stdin
run_get_parser: run get_parser to build an argparse parser with a required unit-dict argument
run_main: run main to load a unit dictionary and filter stdin lines by valid symbols
review_filter_lexicon: review the filter_lexicon script that filters lexicon entries against a fairseq Dictionary
summarize_main: summarize the main function that filters stdin lines where all items exist in the unit dictionary symbols
